title: WabbleSpec Receipt Base
description: Base receipt structure. All module receipts extend this. A phase without a receipt did not complete (I10).

module.description: Canonical module name matching framework.yaml id

phase.description: Phase this receipt covers. Collapsed = Plan+Execute ran together (I2 gate collapsing)

wave.description: Wave number within the current execution. 0 = pre-execution setup

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when receipt was written

checks_passed.description: Subset of checks_run that passed. Enables PARTIAL status.

evidence.description: Evidence items used. Paths, references, or drawer IDs. Empty array only if execution used no external evidence.

status.description: PASS = all checks passed. FAIL = blocking failure. PARTIAL = some checks passed, execution incomplete.

inputs.description: Upstream receipts read before execution (I10 receipt chain)

outputs.description: Artifacts produced. Paths or named artifacts.

not_tested.description: Required. Explicit list of what was not verified. Empty only when everything was verified. Implied completion is prohibited (I10).

confidence.description: Confidence in output correctness. 1.0 = fully verified. Below 0.7 must be flagged.

failure_reason.description: Required when status = FAIL or PARTIAL. Human-readable failure description.

revise_cycles.description: REVISE cycles consumed. Max 3 per gate (I4). At 3, Attestation required.
